name: What is the best project delivery method for a commercial buildout?

mainEntity.name: Is design-build, design-bid-build, or construction management better for a commercial project?
mainEntity.text: Is design-build, design-bid-build, or construction management better for a commercial project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right delivery method depends on the owner’s priorities. Design-build can be faster because design and construction move together, which is useful for projects with tight opening dates. Design-bid-build gives the owner more separation between design and construction, which can help with comparison shopping and independent design control. Construction management can offer more coordination and flexibility on complex projects where sequencing and budget control matter. The best option depends on the project size, permit complexity, and how much the owner wants to be involved in decisions. A commercial project manager should help evaluate the tradeoffs rather than pushing every project into the same structure. In Los Angeles, delivery method choice can also affect how quickly the team can respond to permit and procurement issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best delivery method depends on speed, budget certainty, design control, and how much risk the owner wants to manage. Design-build often works well when speed matters, while construction management can provide more oversight and flexibility.
